India's First Bullet Train Set for May 2027 Operations

India's first bullet train is planned to begin operations in May 2027. The Surat-Bilimora section is ready, and the train is expected to reach a speed of 280 km/h. The Union Railway Minister addressed questions regarding the initial trial runs and speed.
